name: bolivia-transfer-pricing
description: Bolivia transfer pricing for 2026 under Ley 843 arts. 45, 45 bis and 45 ter (text of Ley 549 of 2014), the regulation DS 2227 and SIN resolutions RND 10-0008-15 (as amended by RND 102600000014 of April 2026) and RND 102600000016 (low- or no-tax list, May 2026). Covers who is a related party, including any dealings with a listed low-tax country, the arm's length rule, the six methods, the value range from the comparables' minimum and maximum and the adjustment to its midpoint, intra-group services, the filing thresholds (Form 601 from Bs 7,500,000 of related-party operations, plus the transfer pricing study from Bs 15,000,000), the deadline with the IUE return, filing through the SIAT and Da Vinci, and the formal-duty fines. Trigger on: Bolivia transfer pricing, precios de transferencia, partes vinculadas, Formulario 601, estudio de precios de transferencia, EPT, Ley 549, DS 2227, países de baja o nula tributación Bolivia.
